theorems.name: Submission.cmcdtfrfic_coeff_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (α : Covector (Euclid P) k), (∀ I : Fin k → Fin P, StrictMono I → |α (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (I j) (1 : ℝ))| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) ∧ ∀ ι : Fin (k + 1) → Fin P, StrictMono ι → ∑ i : Fin (k + 1), (α (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (ι (i.succAbove j)) (1 : ℝ))) ^ 2 ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α ^ 2
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
